dedupe_keys.name: software and examples for mechanised safety verification for a distributed autonomous railway control system

description: Robert Sachtleben publishes formalisation and simulation artefacts for a distributed autonomous railway control system. The April 2024 Zenodo ZIP archive fixes a specific Bitbucket revision and is freely available under CC BY 4.0. The describing paper, confirmed in DTU’s publication database as published in 2025, studies train communication with switch boxes and uses Isabelle/HOL to prove interlocking safety under stated network conditions. The artefacts can support experiments with distributed railway control and checks of model assumptions before simulation. The scope is a generic network formulation, not a named operating railway. Toolchain versions, included network examples and practical deployment performance remain unknown from the inspected metadata. No related catalogue record explicitly identifies this implementation. The archive was not downloaded, and neither proofs nor simulations were rerun.
